credits.name: Sportsbook Review online MLB odds archives
credits.credit: 2010-2020 closing moneylines and run lines from the static mlb-odds-YYYY.xlsx archives. Downloaded once and committed as processed games. Not a live scrape.

credits.name: mlb_odds_dataset.json
credits.credit: 2021-04-01 through 2025-08-16 from the static GitHub release asset only. The scraper's code is not run. Closing price is the median current line across the books in that file.

credits.name: ESPN MLB scoreboard and closing odds
credits.credit: Games and closes after 2025-08-16 from the ESPN scoreboard and the ESPN core odds close.

gaps: Scores run through 2026-10-28. Moneylines run through 2026-10-28.
2010 through 2025-08-16 stay the frozen Sportsbook Review archives plus the static mlb_odds_dataset.json release. That release is not updated.
From the day after 2025-08-16, games and closes are the ESPN scoreboard and the ESPN closing line. Spring training and the All-Star game are dropped.
2010-2013 archive rows do not have a usable run line, so those seasons have moneylines and no spread. A stored number outside -2.5 to 2.5 is dropped.

2010-2020 archives do not mark the postseason, so those playoff games sit inside the regular-season totals. From 2021-04-01, playoffs are game types F, D, L, and W, and ESPN postseason games are phase playoff.
The 2021 overlap is deduped. A release game replaces the archive row with the same date and teams.
OAK and ATH are one franchise (Athletics). ARI and AZ are the Diamondbacks.

definitions.season: Calendar year of the MLB season.
definitions.phase: regular or playoff. Playoff is reliable only from 2021-04-01.
definitions.moneyline: Flat 1.00 unit at the closing decimal price. A tie would be a refund. Archive source id is sbr-close. Release source id is release-current-median.
definitions.runLine: Optional run line, graded with the same cover rule as ATS after converting the home number so a positive line means home is laying runs. Pushes are refunds. This is not an NFL/NBA ATS market.
definitions.calibration: Two-way moneyline de-vig, 5-point probability buckets, Brier score, and average overround.
definitions.sampleSize: played, bets, and pushes are separate. 2010-2020 regular-season counts include unmarked playoff games.
